# Copilot Instructions

Systematically work through each item in the WhatsApp Micro-Store scaffold checklist. Update this file as you complete each step.

- [x] Clarify Project Requirements
  - Created comprehensive requirements.md
  - Documented core features and integrations
  - Listed technical requirements and dependencies
- [x] Scaffold the Project
  - Next.js with App Router is set up
  - TypeScript configuration is in place
  - Essential dependencies are installed
- [x] Customize the Project
  - Configured Supabase connection
  - Set up WhatsApp API integration
  - Configured payment providers (Stripe & Razorpay)
- [x] Install Required Extensions
  - Set up VS Code extensions for development
    - Tailwind CSS IntelliSense
    - ESLint
    - Prettier
    - Jest Runner
    - Thunder Client
  - Configure testing tools and debugging
    - Added launch configurations
    - Set up tasks for testing
    - Configured ESLint and Prettier
- [x] Compile the Project
  - Ensured clean build
  - Fixed TypeScript errors
    - Added proper database types
    - Fixed any type issues
    - Updated API responses
- [ ] Create and Run Task
  - Set up development tasks
  - Configure build tasks
  - Set up test tasks
- [ ] Launch the Project
  - Start development server
  - Run initial tests
- [ ] Ensure Documentation is Complete
  - Update README
  - Add API documentation
  - Include setup instructions

Refer to the main README for setup and usage.
